_doc: Headwaters source registry - Chennai episodic sources. Schema + design notes: docs/specs/headwaters.md (local). Validate: npm run data:check. Baseline/accept: scripts/check-upstream-editions.ts --accept <id>.

sources.notes: NWMP annual River Water Quality listing; year pages (e.g. nwmp-data-2) appear as new links, typically Jan-Mar. Serves Chennai (4 rivers/10 stations), Bengaluru (Vrishabhavathi/Arkavathy/Dakshina Pinakini), Madurai (Vaigai 10059/10060). Host has broken TLS and was fully unreachable on 2026-07-21 even with curl -k from a residential IP - check-failures expected until CPCB recovers; retry before changing this entry.
